prompt: I'm 54 and was diagnosed with epithelioid hemangioendothelioma, a rare cancer in the lining of my blood vessels. A biopsy confirmed it, it's been growing and causing symptoms, and my surgeon says it can't be removed with surgery so I need a drug treatment. I get around fine on my own. I live in Boston.
expected_title: SARC046: A Phase II Trial of Nab-Sirolimus in Patients With Progressing or Symptomatic Epithelioid Hemangioendothelioma

prompt: I'm a 71-year-old man with metastatic prostate cancer that keeps growing even though my testosterone is low (castration-resistant). A biopsy confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate, and a PSMA PET scan showed it's PSMA-positive. I'm still active and able to care for myself. I live in Boston.
expected_title: Study Comparing AAA817+ARPI Versus Standard of Care in Adult Participants With PSMA-positive mCRPC

prompt: My son is 6 years old and has a severe seizure disorder. Genetic testing confirmed it's caused by a KCNT1 gene mutation (a developmental and epileptic encephalopathy). His seizure medications have been at a stable dose for a while. We live in Boston.
expected_title: A First-in-human Study of S230815 in Pediatric Participants With KCNT1-related Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy

prompt: I'm 40 and have had non-segmental vitiligo for about two years, with white patches spreading on my body and face. It covers roughly 15% of my body and some of my face, and my dermatologist says it's active. I live in Boston.
expected_title: A Study of LY4005130 in Adult Participants With Non-Segmental Vitiligo

prompt: I'm 67 with chronic lymphocytic leukemia that has come back. A few years ago I finished a fixed course of venetoclax plus an anti-CD20 antibody and went into remission, but more than two years later it has progressed again and my doctor says I need treatment. I live in Boston.
expected_title: Study to Assess Change in Disease Activity and Adverse Events of Oral Venetoclax With Intravenous (IV) Obinutuzumab in Adult Participants With Recurring Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL)

prompt: I'm 63 with advanced non-small cell lung cancer that has spread and can't be cured with surgery or radiation. Testing showed an EGFR exon 19 deletion, and I haven't had any systemic treatment yet for the advanced disease. I live in Boston.
expected_title: A Study of Amivantamab in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors Including Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR)-Mutated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

prompt: I'm 58 with newly diagnosed head and neck squamous cell cancer in my throat (oropharynx, p16 negative), stage IVA. My doctors say I'm a candidate for chemotherapy and radiation together, and I'm still fully active. I live in Boston.
expected_title: A Study of JNJ-90301900 in Combination With Chemoradiation Therapy in Participants With Locally Advanced Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

prompt: I'm a healthy 32-year-old with no medical problems and I'd like to volunteer for an HIV vaccine study. I'm willing to come in for all the follow-up visits over the next year. I live in Boston.
expected_title: Phase 1 Study of CH505 HIV Vaccine Nanoparticles and mRNA Boosters in Healthy Adults

prompt: I'm 44 and have had hidradenitis suppurativa for several years, with painful lumps in my armpits and groin for well over a year in more than one area of my body. I'm not pregnant. I live in Worcester.
expected_title: Targeting Nociceptors in Hidradenitis Suppurativa

prompt: I'm a 29-year-old woman who has had type 1 diabetes for 10 years. I use an insulin pump and a continuous glucose monitor, my A1c is around 7.2, and my BMI is 24. I'm not on a weight-loss diet and I see my diabetes team regularly. I live in Boston.
expected_title: Effects of Ketosis on Brain Function in Patients With T1DM

prompt: I'm 52 and had a bone marrow transplant. Now I have chronic graft-versus-host disease affecting my skin and mouth. I haven't started any new immune-suppressing medication in the last couple of weeks. I live in Boston.
expected_title: Belumosudil for the Pre-emptive Treatment of Patients With Chronic Graft Versus Host Disease

prompt: I'm 61 with multiple myeloma that has relapsed. I've had two prior lines of treatment, my blood tests still show measurable M-protein, and my doctor says it's refractory. I live in Boston.
expected_title: A Study to Investigate Subcutaneous Isatuximab in Combination With Weekly Carfilzomib and Dexamethasone in Adult Participants With Relapsed and/or Refractory Multiple Myeloma

prompt: I'm 59 with newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, the germinal center B-cell subtype confirmed on biopsy. A PET scan shows active disease and I haven't started any treatment yet. I live in Boston.
expected_title: A Clinical Study of Zilovertamab Vedotin (MK-2140) Plus Rituximab Plus Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, and Prednisone (R-CHP) Versus Polatuzumab Vedotin Plus R-CHP in People With Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) (MK-2140-011/waveLINE-011)

prompt: I'm a 48-year-old woman who had breast cancer treated more than three years ago, including removal of a lot of lymph nodes under my arm (over ten of them). I don't have lymphedema and I've had no other surgery on that arm. I'd like to join a lymphatic drainage study. I live in Boston.
expected_title: Mapping and Quantifying Lymphatic Drainage of the Arm's Alternate Pathway

prompt: I'm a 66-year-old man with prostate cancer confirmed on biopsy. I'm about to start 6 months of hormone therapy (ADT) and have never had any GnRH treatment before. My testosterone is above 200 and I'm otherwise well. I live in Boston.
expected_title: RecoverPC: Relugolix vs GnRH Agonist in Quality of Life

prompt: I'm 46 with severe itching all over that's lasted more than six months. My doctors have ruled out skin, nerve, psychiatric and drug causes, so they call it chronic itch of unknown origin. It affects my trunk, arms and legs, and moisturizers haven't helped. I live in Brighton.
expected_title: A Study to Evaluate Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of Remibrutinib in Adult Participants With Severe Chronic Pruritus of Unknown Origin (CPUO)

prompt: I'm a 42-year-old woman who carries a BRCA1 mutation. I've decided to have risk-reducing surgery to remove my tubes and ovaries, and I still have at least one intact ovary and fallopian tube. I live in Boston.
expected_title: A Study to Compare Two Surgical Procedures in Individuals With BRCA1 Mutations to Assess Reduced Risk of Ovarian Cancer

prompt: I'm a 34-year-old woman going through IVF. This is my own (autologous) cycle, I only had a few embryos (fewer than five), and we're planning a fresh embryo transfer without genetic testing. My BMI is 26 and this is my first IVF cycle. I live in Boston.
expected_title: Cleavage-stage Versus Blastocyst-stage Embryo Transfer in IVF Patients With Few Embryos

prompt: I'm 47 with moderate-to-severe Crohn's disease diagnosed over a year ago. Standard treatments haven't worked well enough for me and I've stayed on a stable dose of my current medications. I live in Boston.
expected_title: A Study to Investigate Efficacy and Safety of Brivekimig in Participants With Crohn's Disease

prompt: I'm 38 and have had a port-wine stain birthmark on my arm since birth. It's a flat red mark covering a large area, bigger than a postcard and not on my face. I'm willing to use sunscreen and come to laser treatment visits. I live in Boston.
expected_title: Tolerability of 532 nm Laser Treatment of Port Wine Stains
